name: arcgram
description: Generate an interactive node-and-edge diagram as a single standalone HTML file — pan, zoom, hover tooltips, color-coded categories, and orthogonal edge routing. No build step, no npm, no CDN, no runtime; open in any browser. Ships the Arcgram authoring skill plus the Checkpoint, Reconcile, and Validate self-check skills. Agent-neutral: reads as plain markdown on any framework.
